title: Flowable shipped an immutable business audit trail in December 2025
content:
The release notes for 2025.2.01, dated 16 December 2025, state: *"Added support to see the business audit trail of a case or process instance."* The Enterprise `AuditService` documentation asserts *"Created AuditInstances are immutable"*, with a builder carrying `creatorId()` for user attribution, `type()`, `subType()` and `payload()`, stored in `flw_audit_instance` and publishable as an audit stream.

Controlled code search confirms which side of the line it falls on: `AuditService`, `AuditInstance` and `flw_audit_instance` each return zero hits in `flowable-engine`, against 628 for `HistoryService` as a control. The capability is Enterprise-only, and it exists.

Any pitch asserting that Flowable has no immutable business audit log is factually wrong against the commercial product. The claim survives only when scoped explicitly to the Apache-2.0 edition.
description: Release 2025.2.01 added a business audit trail view and the Enterprise AuditService documents its records as immutable, closing the gap in the vendor's own product.
